spec.name: Furniture Coffin Chest
spec.description: A closed, stepped coffin chest in weathered dark oak, with two forged iron bands and a small raised brass crescent. Its narrow foot faces negative Z. All 22 cuboids are axis-aligned, physically connected, and contained within the requested margins.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: closed horizontal coffin storage chest with iron bands and small brass moon. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..16, y=0..16, z=0..32; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
